instruction: Candid outdoor medium wide shot in a park. On the left, the large Black man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) points to the right while holding a blue frisbee. On the right, the woman in a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans (R4) gestures back at him. In the background, the East Asian man in a red polo (R3) claps, and the woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) holds a red frisbee over her face. Bright daylight illuminates the scene.
